card.name: Lists of infections in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "include" or a comma or similar linking word inside a list of infections, right before the next infection name. Typical settings are infection warnings in immunosuppressant labels and lists of skin reactions.

modes.label: Reported infections include
modes.description: The word "include" right after "Reported infections", before a list that starts with tuberculosis.

modes.label: Comma in infection list
modes.description: A comma after one pathogen or infection name, before the next one in the list.
modes.example: unistic infections due to bacterial, mycobacterial, invasive fungal, viral, parasitic, or other opportunistic pathogens including aspergillosis<<,>> blastomycosis, candidiasis

modes.label: Skin reaction list
modes.description: A word in a list of skin adverse reactions, just before the word infection.
modes.example: allergic contact dermatitis,<< secondary>> infection, striae and miliar

card.writes: It seems to push toward words starting with "abs", such as abscess, as the next item in an infection list.
card.plain: It fires at spots in infection lists where the next item could be something like abscess.
